name: Company Discovery
description: Recurring scan that finds new company domains in Threads/Meetings and adds them to Entities.md for review -- the real Hermes cron job behind this is new-company-discovery (every 24 hours), running the new-company-discovery Skill. Classification (Customer/Partner/Affiliate/Ignore) happens separately, conversationally, when the operator reviews an entry -- not on this recurring schedule.

steps.name: Scan Threads for Domains
steps.description: Extracts participant email domains from every Thread not yet resolved to a known company.

steps.name: Scan Meetings for Domains
steps.description: Extracts attendee email domains from every Meeting not yet resolved to a known company.

steps.name: Filter Known Domains
steps.description: Drops any domain already resolved to an existing Customer/Partner/Affiliate hub note.

steps.name: Add to Entities.md
steps.description: Appends each genuinely new domain to Work/Entities.md as a pending review entry -- never auto-classified.
